QF.id: Retirement Planning Products: National Pension System (NPS)_94

question.text: Sanjay, a non-salaried professional, earns Rs.20 lakh gross income. What is his maximum 80CCD(1) deduction for NPS?

explanation.text: The Logic: For non-salaried individuals, 80CCD(1) allows deduction up to 20 percent of gross income, subject to the overall 80C cap of Rs.1.5 lakh. 20 percent of Rs.20 lakh is Rs.4 lakh, but the deduction is capped at Rs.1.5 lakh. The Trap: Candidates often pick Rs.4 lakh after computing 20 percent of gross income, forgetting that 80CCD(1) sits within the Rs.1.5 lakh 80C umbrella. Note: For salaried individuals the limit is 10 percent of Basic plus DA, also within the Rs.1.5 lakh 80C cap.
